notes.title: v0.7.8 - Maintenance Worker Skill Update & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[p align="start"]Hello, Ranchers 😀🧑🏻‍🌾🐮

We’ve just rolled out a new update that improves employee skills and fixes several issues reported by the community. This update focuses on making waste and nutrient management more streamlined, while also ensuring a smoother overall gameplay experience.

Here are some of the key points we heard from you:

Players want maintenance workers to also handle animal waste and dead plant, moving them into nutrient machines and storage.

Players suggested that maintenance workers should be able to use buckets or directly place waste into processing machines.

Players find it difficult to clean animal pens and planter boxes manually, and they’d like maintenance workers to handle that more efficiently.

Based on your feedback, we’ve added several new features and improvements to better support your needs. We're continuing to improve iteratively and incrementally, delivering meaningful updates step by step 😀




Employee Skill Update: Maintenance Worker
We’ve updated the abilities of the maintenance worker to make them smarter and more efficient when handling waste and nutrients. With this update, they now follow a clearer workflow:

If a waste bucket is available, employees will collect waste using the bucket.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/236c1f06b0066325365ddca59703874c74f0aae2.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/518bd96e7cff8222277382f478cb1eea63f60884.jpg"]

If a waste bucket and nutrient machine are available, employees will collect waste using the bucket and then fill it into the nutrient machine.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/975d3af5daf1aac3895e64f393dcf1b408cfdfa4.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/3bff5db60b2d28dce4db5eb008bc707f8fdc3237.jpg"]

If you have nutrient storage, employees will automatically transfer nutrients from the machine into storage.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/571b0a8b196c89520460543ea4cf4c66b6110273.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/e425b026176e2b94581ea3509c47f35dddf7b8e7.jpg"]

If no nutrient storage is available, employees will deliver nutrients from the machine to the delivery table instead.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/ee1935825ca281b6e99bdbf89adf3c74b15c4f3f.jpg"]

These changes make it much easier to manage waste and nutrient flows without constant micromanagement.




[hr][/hr][p align="start"]
Bug Fixes & Optimization
We’ve also addressed several issues to keep your farm running smoothly:

Fixed a bug where empty nutrients could be stored in nutrient storage.

Fixed an issue where the salesperson stopped at the farm entrance.

Fixed a bug where employee settings were not being saved in kiosks and production tools.

Removed irrelevant employee settings from the composter.

Fixed an issue where the goat icon displayed as a cow when deployed to an animal pen.

Fixed a bug where kiosk stock decreased even when customers didn’t complete a purchase.





Thank you for playing and supporting the game. Your feedback continues to shape every improvement we make. We hope these updates bring more flexibility, smoother workflows, and a more enjoyable experience to your farm.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]As always, if you enjoy the game we’d be grateful if you leaving a review, and don’t hesitate to leave your thoughts or suggestions in the Discussions section. 😀
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Happy playing! 😀🐄🐓

notes.title: v0.2.10 - Polishing, Balancing & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello, Ranch Farmers! 🧑🏻‍🌾



Thank you for your valuable input through both in-app feedback and the Steam Discussion forums, we’ve been able to implement several updates. We’re excited to bring you another update for the Demo version of Ranch Farm and Store Simulator. Let’s take a look at what’s new!


Balancing Updates[olist]
Furniture Now Unlocks at Level 4 

To ensure a smoother gameplay curve, furniture is now available from Level 4 onwards. This helps players gradually customize their space as they progress.

Orange Cat Can Chase Wild Animals Right After Purchase

In this update, the Orange Cat Guardian has been enhanced. Unlike the Beagle Dog, it can immediately chase and scare off wild animals automatically after being purchased, providing immediate support in protecting your farm.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/a0f3947bf77d291b2a9e1d1c6ddde6ff8c09c554.jpg"]

Inventory Storage Moved to Level 5 

Inventory expansion is now available at Level 5 instead of earlier. This change spaces out progression and adds a sense of reward.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/78c7c282a84317211d1225b9be82b0bd42b69a43.jpg"]

Fishing Distance Made Shorter 

You can now fish from a closer range, making fishing easier and more accessible. This small tweak improves convenience without reducing challenge.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/fc5c86df6796d100e8ffa4bf7d71e7981577b74d.jpg"]

Wool Pricing Increased

Wool now sells for a higher price than apples, making it a more profitable resource. This helps balance product values across the farm economy.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/c3447ed45edd152c37274f2e1dec672a256630bd.jpg"]
[/olist]QoL Updates[olist]
Guardian UI Shows Price Before Unlock 

You can now see the price of locked Guardians in the UI. This transparency helps players plan and save up for their farm protectors.

Furniture Bonus Effects

We’ve verified that furniture bonus effects are now properly applied in-game. This ensures that your purchases bring real advantages.

Cashier Bonus Effect Visible in UI 

Bonus effects from furniture are now clearly shown on the cashier interface. You’ll be able to see exactly how your setup impacts operations.
[/olist]

Bug Fixes & Visual Adjustments[olist]
Lake Wave Animation Adjustment

We’ve adjusted the lake wave animation to be slower and smoother. The horizontal and vertical wave motion now flows at half the previous speed for a more relaxing visual.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/53de43efdbbb4ce99bd607fb97d48162d74dcd9b.jpg"]

Fish Commodity Mesh Now Displays Properly 

Previously, the 3D mesh of fish disappeared when placed in the commodity inventory. This has been resolved and your fish will now appear correctly.

Fish Box Clipping When Overfilling Food Bowl

Previously, placing fish boxes into an overfilled food bowl caused them to get stuck. This has been resolved so feeding your animals is now smoother and bug-free.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/098323e95e218ee21839de606a60b40bfe856f0a.jpg"]

Wool Harvesting Bug with Employees
There was an issue where employees couldn’t harvest wool properly. This has now been fixed, and your workers can collect wool without any problems.

3D Audio Channels Fixed
The left and right 3D audio channels were inverted, making directional sounds feel off. This has been corrected by rotating the sound source by 180 degrees.

Orange Size Adjusted for Consistency
Oranges placed in boxes, shelves, and inventory were smaller than the ones on the tree. Their size has now been increased to match the tree fruit visuals more accurately.

Plant Naming Corrections
Plant types are now properly categorized and named as trees, plants, shrubs, or bushes. This improves clarity in classification and item management.

Fishing Rod Translation Fix
The translation for “Traditional Fishing Rod” has been corrected for consistency and clarity across languages.
[/olist]


Thank you for playing the demo and supporting the development. Your feedback helps shape what’s next. Try the latest build and let us know what you think. 🐓🥬



We always open to all feedback and suggestions to make this game as mature as possible. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, don’t hesitate to share your thoughts.



Cheers!

notes.title: First Update into the Field
notes.notes:
Hello, ranchers and future store tycoons!

We’re beyond excited to announce our upcoming game Ranch, Farm & Store Simulator, where you’ll experience the full journey of rural life, from raising animals and growing crops to managing your own country store! Whether you’re a casual player or a management sim enthusiast, this game offers everything you need to build a thriving ranch, a productive farm, and a successful local business.

As we kick off development, we’ve made several improvements and additions to enhance the early gameplay experience:

1. Smoother New Game Transition
We’ve replaced the initial tweening animation for store title changes with a fade-to-black effect to give the start of the game a cleaner, more immersive feel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/a70df8acfe8310430fcdd9c4d69dd9167c45a910.jpg

2. New Tools Added
Chainsaw, Fishing Rods, Bags, and raw commodity processing machines are added in the tools menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/b6316bc0a3fecfbb0981cf2970bdee5cd612b3d3.jpg

3. Livestock Yield Balancing
We’re working on improving the output of animal commodities. The new system will allow animals to produce larger quantities of goods steadily until the end of their lifespan, making livestock farming more rewarding in the long run.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/26dea9353a6804dc10c7f4ca37ad6e70c33363e5.jpg

4. More Crop Types
We're also developing new types of livestock and crops to expand the farming possibilities. These additions are still in progress, and we’re excited to share more once they’re ready.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631152/50715e2e30d1208009b4e39cb58a62ff71a1ff3d.jpg

That wraps up our very first development update for Ranch, Farm & Store Simulator!
We’re still in the early stages, but each step brings us closer to delivering a solid gameplay experience that blends ranching, farming, and store management. 

Stay tuned for more updates, and don’t forget to let us know what you’d love to see in the game. 🌾🛒

Cheers!
